Supreme Court hears contempt pleas over Delhi protest clampdown

The Supreme Court indicated it sees grounds for contempt proceedings in a plea concerning actions taken during Delhi protests. The court issued a notice to authorities after finding a 'prima facie case' in the contempt plea related to the metro clampdown. The court stated it would hear all parties involved in the contempt pleas against the clampdown in Delhi. Separately, the Supreme Court held advocate Prashant Bhushan guilty of contempt for his tweets against the judiciary and the Chief Justice of India.
